Honest note: a phone has no projector lens, so it cannot throw a picture onto a wall by itself. ShakeLight gives you the two ways that really work:

• Connect to a projector or TV — wirelessly (Cast, Smart View, Screen mirroring) or with a USB-C to HDMI cable. When the projector appears as a second screen, the picture plays there and your phone becomes the remote.

• DIY lens box — put the phone in a dark shoebox with a magnifying glass in the front, in a dark room. Turn on “Rotate 180°” so the picture lands upright on the wall.
No second screen connected — the picture will show on this phone (or on a TV if you mirror your screen).
